title: [Certain persons who have filed appeals to the Appellate Tribunal entitled to make applications
text:
22M. [Certain persons who have filed appeals to the Appellate Tribunal entitled to make applications

_to the Settlement Commission.]—Omitted by the Finance Act, 1987, s. 87 (w.e.f. 1-6-1987). Earlier it was_
_inserted by Act_ 41 of 1975, _s._ 93 (w.e.f. 1-4-1976) _which was later amended by Act 67_ _of 1984, s. 64_
(w.e.f. 1-10-1984).

CHAPTER VI

APPEALS, REVISIONS AND REFERENCES
